component.name: PICO Trackers
component.summary: PICO Motion Trackers in SteamVR over Steam Link
PICO Motion Trackers в SteamVR через Steam Link

description.p: Brings PICO Motion Trackers into SteamVR when you play PC VR on a PICO 4 / 4 Pro over Steam Link: a SteamVR driver, an app for the headset and this program, which installs them, shows the state of the trackers (connection, calibration, battery) and turns trackers on and off on the fly.

Передаёт PICO Motion Trackers в SteamVR, когда вы играете в ПК-VR на PICO 4 / 4 Pro через Steam Link: драйвер SteamVR, приложение для шлема и эта программа, которая их ставит, показывает состояние трекеров (подключение, калибровка, заряд) и включает и выключает трекеры на лету.

Battery of each PICO tracker by body place (left leg, right leg, waist) in the program and SteamVR, own tracker icons in SteamVR, connection and calibration state read from the headset's tracking service, --dev for testing own builds.
Calibrate PICO trackers from the PC, tracker battery in the program and SteamVR, English interface, AppImage and Flatpak.
